title: Terms of use
intro: By using web3.toys you agree to these terms. They are written to be short and readable.

sections.title: Education only
list: Everything on web3.toys is for learning. Nothing here is financial, investment, legal or tax advice.
Crypto is risky. You can lose all the money you put in. Do your own research and talk to a qualified adviser before you invest.

sections.title: Your account
list: You must be 18 or over to create an account or buy anything.
Keep your login safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account.
We may remove accounts that cheat, spam or abuse the site, including faking scores or coins.

sections.title: Coins
list: Coins are points on this site only. They have no cash value.
Coins can never be withdrawn, sold, transferred or exchanged for money, crypto or tokens.
Coins can unlock cosmetic extras and some paid items on this site, at the coin prices shown. Items unlocked with coins are not refundable for coins or money.
Coin tasks pay once each. Posts and invites must be genuine: we may remove coins earned by faking tasks, fake accounts or self-invites.
We may change how coins are earned, what they unlock and coin prices.

sections.title: Certificates and Pro tags
list: Certificates show you finished a toy or passed a quiz on web3.toys. They are not a professional qualification.

sections.title: Early Bird
list: For each toy, the first 1,000 logged-in players to earn its certificate from that toy's Early Bird start get a numbered Early Bird spot and double coins on that toy. One spot per account per toy.
Spots are handed out by our database in the order certificates are saved. Spot numbers and the number of spots are final once shown, except where we remove them for cheating.
Early Bird gives coins and a badge only. It has no cash value, like all coins.
We may change Early Bird for future toys; spots already given stay.

sections.title: New toys and release dates
list: Release dates on the site are our plan, not a promise. A toy can come out later or earlier than shown.
Notify me emails are sent only to people who asked for them, and only about the toy they chose.

sections.title: Web3 Hall of Famers
list: Web3 Hall of Famers describes real people from public information, for learning. Being listed is not an endorsement, and cautionary tales are included as lessons, not role models.
Portraits are drawings, not photos. If something about a person is wrong or out of date, email hi@web3.toys and we will check and fix it.
Favourite-builder votes and the percentages of players who named someone are for fun. One vote per account; we may remove votes from fake accounts.

sections.title: Purchases
list: Prices are shown before you pay, in Indian rupees or US dollars. Crypto payments are for the US dollar price, converted at checkout. Taxes are added where the law requires.
Digital products (reports, certificates, exports and books) are delivered as downloads in your account straight after payment.
Refunds follow our Refunds page.

sections.title: Project listings and custom toys
list: Payment does not guarantee listing. Every project passes our vetting checklist first, and we refund in full if we decline.
We may remove a listed course or toy if we later find the project is misleading, unsafe or breaks the law.

sections.title: Paid product testing
list: Testers must be 18 or older, have an account and the rank shown on the Testers page.
Testers only use testnets or a fresh, empty wallet. Never use real funds and never enter a recovery (seed) phrase anywhere. If a product asks for one, stop and report it.
Payment is for the testing work you do, not a reward for playing. It is paid in USDC or USDT to the wallet you give us, after the team approves your test, usually within 14 days.
We may decline tests that are rushed, copied or fake, and close accounts that use more than one profile. Declined tests are not paid.
You are responsible for any taxes on what you are paid. Payments sent to the address and network you gave us cannot be reversed, so check them carefully.
Coins for tests are site points with no cash value. web3.toys never pays in or promotes tokens.
What you write and your screenshots are shared with the project that asked for the test. Do not include personal details in them.

sections.title: Calls
list: Calls are general guidance for learning, not personal financial advice. See the Refunds page for missed or moved calls.

sections.title: Content and templates
list: Agreement templates and tool results are starting points only. Have a qualified lawyer in your country review any agreement before signing.

sections.title: Limits of our responsibility
list: We do our best to keep information accurate, but we cannot promise it is complete or up to date.
To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for losses from decisions you make using this site.

sections.title: Law
list: These terms are governed by the laws of India, and any dispute goes to the courts of Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.
web3.toys is run by Build With Aki, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Contact: hi@web3.toys.
